title: Vow and Letters
author: O. M. Lockridge
blurb: Lena Vasquez, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the bakery lease runs out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
